digest.component_or_area: plan-review T10 overlay rubric and evaluation spec
propositions: T10 rubric must partition durable-infrastructure checks from transient de-risk experiments via an exact scope clause while retaining all four MAJOR safety classes.

The four MAJOR safety classes (destructive apply, wildcard-admin access, plaintext secret, untrusted-endpoint auth) must remain in scope for transient infrastructure despite the durable-infrastructure scope carve-out.

T10 rubric must include an exact co-located safety qualifier immediately after the scope clause that explicitly names the four preserved MAJOR classes and must not delegate scope to T15 or any other overlay.

The packaged eval spec must contain ten balanced dataset cases: five pass controls for scoped transient teardown, durable infrastructure, private-network IAM, secret-manager retrieval, and sandboxed teardown; five finding controls for under-specified durable lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext secret, and untrusted-network transient service.
Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause, exact safety qualifier, exact adjacency, absence of T15 references, and rubric independence against prompt modification.
Live criterion evaluation across three runs must report pass for all five benign cases and finding for all five unsafe cases with full recall, zero false accept, and stable agreement.
